description: List stock transfer orders (warehouse→warehouse moves) for reconciliation / status reporting — e.g. to confirm a transfer you just created landed. Filters (all optional, AND-combined): status (created, pending, picking, picked, packing, packed, shipping, shipped, delivered, canceled — unknown values are rejected); type (tra [stock transfer, default all], wof [write-off]); sku (only transfers with a line for that exact SKU, case-insensitive). Newest first. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500. Each row is an order-level summary (source/target warehouse, status, line count, total) — not line detail. A client-pinned token sees only transfers made up of its own client's items; an operator token sees the whole tenant's.

sku.description: Return only transfers containing a line for this exact SKU (case-insensitive).

status.description: Exact status filter (e.g. created, pending, shipped, delivered); omit for all.

type.description: Document type: tra (stock transfer) or wof (write-off); omit for all.

name: get_transfer_orders
title: List Transfer Orders
